camel_example: aliyun aideepsign CreateWatermarkExtractTask --region cn-hangzhou --FileType video --version 2026-05-11 --method POST --force
description_en: Submits an image or video file to extract a dark watermark and returns a task ID
description_zh: 提交图片或视频文件以提取暗水印，并返回任务ID
name: CreateWatermarkExtractTask

parameters.help_en: A reserved idempotency field. Idempotency is not supported. Passing in a value does not cause an error, but it does not produce an idempotency effect
parameters.help_zh: 预留幂等字段，暂不支持。传入不会报错，但当前不产生幂等效果
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The file type. Valid values: `image` and `video`. The value must be the same as the `FileType` used when the watermark was embedded
parameters.help_zh: 文件类型，取值：`image`（图片）、`video`（视频）。必须与嵌入该水印时的 `FileType` 一致
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en: The URL of the file from which the watermark is to be extracted. Images and videos are supported. Only the `http/https` protocol is supported. Videos must be no longer than 10 minutes and no larger than 100 MB
parameters.help_zh: 待提取水印文件的 URL 地址，支持图片和视频，仅支持 `http/https` 协议；视频仅支持 10 分钟以内、100MB 以内
parameters.name: file_url

parameters.help_en: A reserved field. No valid values are available. Do not pass in this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 预留字段，当前无有效取值，建议调用时不传
parameters.name: reserved

Code.description_en: The business error code. OK is returned if the request is successful
Code.description_zh: 业务错误码。请求成功时返回 OK

HttpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. `200` is returned if the request is successful
HttpStatusCode.description_zh: HTTP 状态码。请求成功时返回 `200`

Message.description_en: The additional information. "success" is returned if the request is successful
Message.description_zh: 附加信息。请求成功时返回 "success"

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

TaskId.description_en: The dark watermark extraction task ID, which is used to call GetWatermarkExtractTaskResult to query the result
TaskId.description_zh: 暗水印提取任务 ID，用于调用 GetWatermarkExtractTaskResult 查询结果
TaskId.title_en: 暗水印提取任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkExtractTaskResult查询
TaskId.title_zh: 暗水印提取任务ID，用于后续GetWatermarkExtractTaskResult查询
